name: brand-battle-copilot-lab
description: A one-hour GitHub Copilot hackathon lab for beginner students.

scripts.start: sh -c 'if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; else exec python3 -m http.server 8000; fi'
scripts.test: node --check app.js && node --check questions.js && node scripts/validate-questions.js
